_comment: select_for is a capability match, not a lookup - if either half of the match (chipset prefix, state membership) stops being checked, a flasher could be handed a device it never declared it can write. This used to pin a third anchor on the RP2040-BOOTSEL carve-out (a known-but-unbuilt route that refused even though the chipset was recognised); Step 13 registered a real Bootsel flasher, so that branch is gone and rp2040+bootsel is now just another entry the loop below has to get right, same as every other route.

mutations.name: state has to be one this flasher actually declares
mutations.find: if state in f.states and any(chipset.startswith(p) for p in f.chipsets):
mutations.replace: if True and any(chipset.startswith(p) for p in f.chipsets):

mutations.name: chipset has to match one of this flasher's own prefixes
mutations.find: if state in f.states and any(chipset.startswith(p) for p in f.chipsets):
